title: Paloma Business Payout Limits Register
content:
The payout amounts a Paloma Business account may send are bounded per plan: a smallest and a largest principal for one payout, a largest sum of payout principal per billing period, a principal above which the business's invoice reference must be given, and a principal at or above which a second user with the approver role must approve before release.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest principal of one payout (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Largest principal of one payout (USD) | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 150000.00 | 400000.00 | 1000000.00 |
| Largest sum of payout principal per billing period (USD) | 25000.00 | 75000.00 | 250000.00 | 750000.00 | 2000000.00 | 5000000.00 |
| Invoice reference required above (USD of principal) | 3000.00 | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 |
| Dual approval at or above (USD of principal) | 0.00, not available | 0.00, not available | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 100000.00 |

### Notes

1. A dual approval figure of 0.00 means dual approval is not available on that plan: Paloma Business Starter and Paloma Business Essentials.
2. The invoice row applies to principal **above** the figure; the dual approval row applies to principal **at or above** the figure.

### Hypothetical readings

- A payout of 5000.00 USD on Paloma Business Essentials is not above that plan's invoice figure of 5000.00 USD; a payout of 5000.01 USD is above it.
- A payout of 10000.00 USD on Paloma Business Growth is at that plan's dual approval figure of 10000.00 USD.
